method: All126 potential high-score negatives received independent Astra raw/source visual review before any weighted fit. Lead inspected Midnight g02, Miracle g14, Heavy g16, BadGuy sheet1, Inhale sheet2 and Tears sheet1 and accepted the conservative dispositions. Existing labels and exclusions are unchanged. Only accepted non-kicks can receive emphasis; every fold must still select by its own baseline score>=.90.
limitations: Provisional source-assisted visual identity, no independent human listening. Inhale9.735s remains tom versus weak kick ambiguity; no label correction. Kick tails can extend beyond the200ms automatic guard.

frozen_rule.baseline: linear15 expanded reviews, refined 223/381 matched and89 unmatched at70ms
frozen_rule.eligibility: Unchanged training_mask and label0. Candidate start/end evidence interval must not intersect any known kick onset[-35ms,+200ms], including context or excluded labels. Independent raw/source review must accept_non_kick; reject ambiguous, potential missing kicks, tails and duplicates. Reviewed eligibility is annotation-only, no model outcomes.
frozen_rule.selection: Within each exact training-song set, score only its eligible negatives using that set's unweighted15feature baseline. Select score>=0.90. Freeze these IDs for both2x4x. No quota, updated-model mining, held-out-song contribution or cutoff-derived selection.
frozen_rule.weights: Multiply selected negative rows then renormalise all negative weights within each song to original half-class mass. Preserve equal-song totals and positive-event weights. Zero selected is a no-op. Keep mean/scale computed with ORIGINAL weights for that same fold, clip8,L2.01,zero initialisation,L-BFGS-B maxiter150 ftol1e-10.
frozen_rule.diagnostics: Primary actual frozen70ms events, precision/recall/unmatched, wide diagnostics, duplicates, associated timing, nine full kick-free cores, original174 pack, expanded207 pack. Same0.5 fixed and current nested refined cutoffs. Within each held-out song, candidate rank-AUC on unchanged trainingmask positives (event-balanced) versus ALL temporally conservative negative candidates (uniform), class score/logit quantiles, paired score changes, and margins. This diagnostic pool is fixed before weighted results and is provisional timing-labelled data, not proof of source identity. Macro song AUC only, no crossfold rawscore pooling. Coefficient changes and fold consistency interpreted as correlated decision directions, not causality.
frozen_rule.milestone: At least223/381 matched70ms, at most70 unmatched, no track loses>1 match versus1x, allninekickfreecoreszero. Ultimate95%precision/recall andreservedvalidation notclaimed.
frozen_rule.stop: Exactlythree settings, no newthresholdprotocol or features. If weights only trade misses for falsefires stop. No reserved audio, externaldata, liveintegration, UI, landing or publicpublishing. Preserve locally.
